lines.text: After entering the land, Israel brings the priest a basket of firstfruits, and he waves it before the LORD.

problems.problem: Its true detail "He waves it" isn't in Leviticus 23:11 word for word.
Its wrong detail "burns it" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
"burns it" and "He waves it" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
